name: a farmer is hired at the grain bin, sows a field of wheat in the good soil, tends it all week and brings the harvest in on the Monday

steps.note: a site of good soil with a grain bin in cell (4, 3), and nothing else to be hired to. The first plot sown is the nearest the bin with the ground open all round it, (2, 2): the two beside the bin have it in their ring
arriving to find the bin free is being hired to it

steps.expect_log: was hired as a farmer at the grain bin at 4, 3

steps.note: every need switched off, tiredness too, so this is a test about the job and a week of it
Monday: ten crops sown round the bin by two in the afternoon, at 1920 ticks a world hour

steps.shot: Monday afternoon: the field sown round the grain bin, a crop looked at

steps.note: to Saturday at three: tended every day since, so in ear and at its best

steps.shot: Saturday afternoon: the field in ear

steps.note: to the next Monday at five: ripe on the Sunday, harvested today, three sheaves a crop at its best, and sown again

steps.shot: the statistics: the farm's wheat and the fields
Monday evening: the harvest in, the grain bin full, the field sown again
